Strategic evolution — October 2026

From dashboard to Operating System for the Cascadia Economy

The demo is the foundation. The strategic evolution is a 20-year composable, AI-native, multi-sided platform that anticipates needs, automates compliance, maps physical supply chains to financial instruments, and embeds itself in the daily workflows of investors, procurement officers, logistics managers, and policymakers. Four permanent principles — modularity, data sovereignty, agentic AI, climate resilience — chosen because they survive technology cycles.

24/7/365 public preview — no NDA, no login, no access request Served via GitHub Pages CDN from the public Demo4VanSea repo. The public repo holds only .html files — all other artifacts (code, .md, .pdf, .json, .js, .png) live exclusively in the private AISeaVanBiz4 source-of-truth repo.
